hero.label: Serendia Holidays by Venom · Sri Lanka
hero.dock: Travel, cricket and hospitality—connected by one Sri Lankan team.

perspective.copy1: Serendia was created in 2019 by people whose careers were already rooted in Sri Lankan tourism, hotel operations and international cricket.
perspective.copy2: That experience changes the questions we ask, the details we notice and the journeys we build.
perspective.altLeopard: Leopard in a Sri Lankan forest
perspective.caption: We plan with the whole island in view—from the quietest road to the busiest match day.

disciplinesSection.copy: Scroll through the three worlds that shape every Serendia journey.

disciplines.title: See the island as one connected story.
disciplines.copy: Private journeys, beach stays, hotels and transport are shaped around your pace—not assembled as separate bookings.

disciplines.title: Tour with people who understand the game.
disciplines.copy: Fixtures, grounds, coaching, supporters and family travel are coordinated by a team with genuine international cricket experience.

disciplines.title: Build the welcome before the first guest arrives.
disciplines.copy: Hotel concepts move from planning and procurement through operations, training and a supported soft opening.

teamSection.title: The people who connect it all.
teamSection.copy: No hand-offs between anonymous departments. The people shaping the idea stay close to the details.

team.copy: 24 years across hotels and travel, including nearly seven years as Executive Secretary of the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.
37 years of hospitality experience across food and beverage leadership, sales and marketing.
Former Sri Lanka Test and One Day international cricketer with more than 20 years in professional cricket and coaching.
Connects travel planning and technology to make every journey clearer, easier and more personal.
Supports the digital systems that keep the company’s day-to-day travel operations moving smoothly.

hotel.title: A hotel is a journey before it is a destination.
hotel.copy: We help investors move from the first practical decisions to an operation ready to welcome its first guests.

hotelJourney.title: Shape
hotelJourney.text: Concept design, construction planning and practical review of the spaces guests and teams will use.

hotelJourney.title: Protect
hotelJourney.text: Project finance, procurement, cost-saving opportunities and statutory documentation.

hotelJourney.title: Prepare
hotelJourney.text: Operational manuals, automation, equipment commissioning, people and marketing plans.

hotelJourney.title: Open
hotelJourney.text: Training, site supervision and hands-on guidance through the hotel soft opening.

closing.title: Your Sri Lanka story starts with someone who knows it.
